look_here_first: Start at the nodes and inflorescence: a taller plant with conspicuously ridged stems, broader opposite leaves, and paired axillary condensed cymes subtended by broad obovate bracts.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: perennial herb, often much taller than Dyschoriste linearis

lookalikes.differences: Taller and broader-leaved than Dyschoriste linearis, with paired bracted cymes instead of solitary axillary flowers.
